name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.10: daily machine digest email with per-product low-stock thresholds. Opt-in per machine on a new Notifications tab, sent at a configurable hour (07:00 by default, Iceland being UTC year-round). Thresholds are absolute counts per machine per product, not percentages: a gravity basket has no capacity the machine can measure, and a capacity setting operators will not fill in yields either silence or nonsense while looking configured. Per-machine scoping also keeps operators isolated, since a threshold on the shared product record would let one operator change anothers alerting, and it matches where demand knowledge lives. Unconfigured products fall back to a default of 2. The email leads with machine status (online, cabinet temperature and whether it is over the limit, app version, revenue today), then sold-out items, then low stock, then open alerts; a machine with nothing to report sends nothing. Adds GET/PUT /machines/:deviceCode/notifications with a live preview of what would be reported. Cumulative over v6.9.1.
